portfolio.title: A small studio making useful things
portfolio.intro: We started with one kiln and a table at a weekend market. Today we make pieces for homes, cafés and other brands.
portfolio.story:
Every piece starts as a sketch and a test batch. We only make what we'd use ourselves.

We work with local makers and pay fairly, and we ship in recycled packaging.
